intent: Unify science, luxury, production and trade with the retained painted economy artwork while preserving their distinct silhouettes.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: high-resolution transparent PNG science symbol for the Atlas HD historical strategy game's economy UI.
Input image: edit target and style reference — our own painted catalog science icon.
Primary request: simplify this into one science flask without the separate gold star. Preserve the richly painted glass, dimensional highlights, dark edge definition, blue-green liquid, and historical hand-painted game-art style.
Subject: one centered clear glass laboratory flask with a broad rounded body, a short narrow OPEN neck and a clearly visible thick glass lip. Remove the star and cork; no detached objects, sparkles or badges. Retain the rich cyan/teal liquid and warm reflected highlights from the reference. Reduce tiny bubbles and busy reflections so the silhouette, glass rim and liquid level remain legible at 14 and 28 pixels.
Composition: square canvas, entire flask visible, centered, about 90% of canvas height, balanced small transparent margins. Strong broad light/dark masses, dimensional painted shading rather than flat vector outlines.
Constraints: real transparent alpha background, no ground plane, no external cast shadow, no text, no watermark. Use only the supplied replacement artwork as reference; no original-game art.

outputs.method: built-in image_gen; star and stopper removed

edits.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: high-resolution transparent PNG production shield for a historical sprite-based strategy game's economy UI.
Input 1 is the edit target: the existing flat blue production shield. Inputs 2 and 3 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: the selected painted antique coin and glass science flask.
Primary request: repaint the shield in the same dimensional, hand-painted game illustration style as the references, while preserving the target's broad, upright heater-shield silhouette, blue color identity, small central peak at its top, curved sides and pointed bottom.
One centered, nearly front-facing shield. Broad blue painted metal face, a restrained raised blue-steel rim, subtle convex shading and lightly worn brush-painted texture. Light from upper left, soft dark-blue edge definition, readable light blue central face. Keep the design simple enough for 10px worked-tile and 14px economy-row icons: broad tones and a recognizable shield outline, not tiny ornamental detail.
No emblem, lettering, stars, grain, crossed weapons, handles, coin motif, gems or extra objects. No perspective tilt, bulky thick black outline, platform, external cast shadow or background. Do not change it into a coat-of-arms badge.
Square canvas, shield occupying about 90% of the canvas height and 80% of its width, balanced transparent margins, entire shape visible. Real transparent alpha background. Rich painted highlights and material shading, not a flat vector or a photographic object. Use only the provided replacement artwork as references.

output.method: built-in image_gen style edit; generated pixels and alpha retained

edits.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: high-resolution transparent PNG trade/exchange arrows for a historical sprite-based strategy game's economy UI.
Input 1 is the edit target: the existing two flat opposed arrows. Inputs 2 and 3 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: the selected painted antique coin and glass science flask.
Primary request: repaint the TWO arrows in the same dimensional, hand-painted game illustration style, preserving their distinct simple geometry and direction: upper warm-gold arrow points RIGHT, lower pale green/verdigris arrow points LEFT. Keep both straight, horizontal, broad and nearly front-facing, with large triangular heads and thick rectangular shafts. Preserve the compact stacked arrangement and a clear narrow gap/edge between the two arrows so they never merge.
Treat them as subtly beveled painted metal shapes: ochre-gold upper arrow and light mint/verdigris lower arrow, modeled highlights from upper left, restrained dark edge shading, brushed/worn painted texture and minimal visible thickness. Broad readable color masses; tiny texture supports HD detail but the opposed arrow silhouettes must read at 10px and 14px. Match the reference coin's painterly richness without copying its decorative features.
No circle, loop, circular arrow, curved ribbon, interlocking knot, signboard, text, stars, coin, flask or other object. No thick black outline, dramatic perspective, background, platform or external cast shadow.
Square canvas, arrows together occupy about 90% of width and 85% of height, balanced small margins, whole shapes visible. Actual transparent alpha background. Painted raster illustration rather than flat vector shapes. Use only the provided replacement artwork as references.

output.method: built-in image_gen style edit; generated pixels and alpha retained
